art_note: High-end lifestyle photography with sophisticated lighting and luxury aesthetic, contrasting with standard flat product shots.
desc_en: A composition fusing urban style with organic delicacy upon a vanilla canvas. The design features a short-sleeve top with structured lapels, a low neckline, and adjustable front laces. It is completed by a mid-rise pleated minifigure skirt. Crafted to offer a body-hugging fit with breathable properties.
desc_es: Una composicion que fusiona el estilo urbano con la delicadeza organica sobre un lienzo vainilla. El diseño presenta un top de manga corta con solapas estructuradas, escote bajo y cordones frontales ajustables. Se completa con una minifalda plisada de talle medio. Confeccionado para ofrecer un ajuste ceñido al cuerpo con propiedades transpirables.
